display.purpose: Public page heroes and landmark statements only; never portal chrome.

body.purpose: Long-form reading; portal UI defaults one step smaller.

label.purpose: Interface workhorse: buttons, labels, meta, dense data.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards; barely-there separation from the page tint.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on interactive cards; popovers.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: Deep green-tinted glow under dark-green public hero panels only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action voice: LMSA green fill, white text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0C8950; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A7343; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #085C36; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0C8950; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined alternative: transparent, 2px green border, floods green tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #0C8950; border: 2px solid #0C8950; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 22px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E8F7F0; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #C1E8D6; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0C8950; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field, 1px border, 8px radius; green focus ring with border drop-away.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #29A37D; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F3F4F6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The portal's base surface: white, 1px border, 12px radius, flat at rest.
components.html:
Anatomy of the Heart — Guest Lecture

Apr 12, 2026 · John F. Kennedy Medical Center
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #4B5563; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }

components.name: Portal Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar row: 44px touch target, 20px icon, green tint + bold on active.
components.html: DashboardEvents
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #4B5563; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F3F4F6; color: #111827; } .ds-nav-active { background: #E8F7F0; color: #064629; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill with dot: tint background, strong same-hue text; color is data.
components.html: Active Pending Inactive
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip-active { background: #E8F7F0; color: #064629; } .ds-chip-pending { background: #FFF8E1; color: #C68400; } .ds-chip-inactive { background: #F3F4F6; color: #4B5563; }

narrative.overview: Everything in this system behaves like a well-kept patient chart: ordered, legible, calm, and impossible to misread. LMSA is a medical association; its interfaces borrow clinical discipline — dense but breathable information, hairline rules instead of heavy chrome, one confident brand green where a decision needs emphasis. Nothing shouts; everything answers. Depth is carried by 1px borders and tonal steps, never by stacked shadows. The brand green is the single voice of action and identity; semantic color families are informative labels, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Border-led, flat surfaces; shadow is a state response, not a resting condition
One action color (LMSA green #0C8950); semantic families carry meaning, never mood
Compact, scan-friendly density with 44px minimum touch targets
Inter for interface, Merriweather for editorial/display moments

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: LMSA green is the only color that may signal "act here." The semantic families inform; they never invite.

rules.name: The Flag Rule
rules.body: Flag red (#DC143C) appears in flag identity and destructive confirmations. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The Chart Rule
rules.body: Color is data. If a color doesn't tell the member something true (status, category, severity), it doesn't appear.

rules.name: The Workhorse Rule
rules.body: text-sm (14px) is the default interface size; text-xs (12px) only for timestamps and captions.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response (hover, focus, open) or as an overlay boundary.

dos: Do use LMSA green (#0C8950) for every primary action, link, and active navigation state.
Do carry structure with 1px #E5E7EB borders and tonal steps; keep resting surfaces flat.
Do keep 44px minimum touch targets on interactive rows, links, and icon buttons.
Do use text-sm (14px) as the interface default and scale type up only for headings.
Do map status to the semantic families: green active, amber pending, gray inactive, red suspended.
donts: Don't introduce a new accent color or use semantic families decoratively.
Don't stack shadows or elevate resting surfaces.
Don't use Flag Red outside flag identity and destructive actions.
Don't mix radius scales within a composite.
Don't use Merriweather inside portal chrome or data UI.
